title: How to review rambu lalu lintas every week
description: How to review rambu lalu lintas every week: the weekly check, what stays stored on your device, and how to get back on track after a gap.
answer: When it matters, rambu lalu lintas lives in three places, and the first one you open is already stale. RuleBook keeps rambu lalu lintas on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.

sections.p: Once a week, look at the part that breaks most often and shrink the target instead of adding willpower.
RuleBook keeps rambu lalu lintas on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.
If you miss several days, do not wipe history. Open the last entry, fill in one day, then close.

list: Pick one fixed time, not “whenever there is room”.
Open RuleBook when that time arrives, not later tonight.
Note one blocker, not a long excuse.
Back up before you switch phones.
faqs: Can I open rambu lalu lintas offline?
Yes. RuleBook keeps everything on-device, so no data plan is needed.
Do I need an account first?
No. Start without login; export a backup from time to time.

What if I miss a few days?
